scope: Internal single-host local file storage of validated C04 bytes with atomic manifest/idempotency publication, tested recovery and bounded state. No HTTP/browser writes, authentication, ingestion, spool or full-product readiness.
owner_scope_resolution: Owner selected storage only. Generic C05 identity/header/browser requirements remain with their owning future cards and are not certified by mock authority.
source_identity_algorithm: SHA-256 of sorted UTF-8 relative path + NUL + raw SHA-256(file bytes); evidence/progress/handoff excluded to avoid recursion. Historical C01-C04 evidence unchanged.

environment.podman: 4.9.3; rootless probe passed; storage requires no container/provider
environment.filesystem: ext4 mounted at /; local tested filesystem

argv: node --version && npx --yes --package=npm@11.9.0 --call 'npm --version' && go version && podman --version && podman info --format '{{.Host.Security.Rootless}}' && uname -sm && findmnt -no FSTYPE,TARGET -T . && git rev-parse HEAD && sha256sum package-lock.json
go test -race -count=1 -v ./... && go vet ./... && python3 -c "import subprocess; assert not subprocess.check_output(['gofmt','-l','internal/storage','tests/storage_test.go']).strip()"
npx --yes --package=npm@11.9.0 --call 'npm run package:web' && cd dist/release && sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS.txt
python3 scripts/validate_repo.py && python3 scripts/plan.py validate && python3 -m unittest discover -s tests/engineering -p 'test_*.py' -v && node scripts/verify-resources.mjs && git diff --check

go test -c -o /tmp/miragemesh-c05-storage-tests ./tests && cd tests && strace -f -e trace=network -o ../docs/evidence/C05/network.trace /tmp/miragemesh-c05-storage-tests -test.run='^TestStorage(ExactBytesReplayAndReopen|OpaqueIDsAndHostileMetadataRemainInert)$' && ! rg 'AF_INET' ../docs/evidence/C05/network.trace

commands.command: GIT_INDEX_FILE=<isolated candidate index> npm run test:clone; real transport clone of same snapshot; go test -race -count=1 ./...; go vet ./...

fixture_provenance_license: Repository-authored synthetic C05 fixture manifests under Apache-2.0. Exact C04 input copied as licensed synthetic data; no live sensor traffic.

results.single_writer: same-process and cross-process lock rejection; concurrent calls serialize
results.durability_protocol: staged exact-byte readback, file sync, immutable object publication, directory sync, atomic manifest replacement and final directory sync before receipt
results.recovery: actual SIGKILL at five boundaries with real child processes; prior/new complete visibility, lock release and replay after lost ACK
results.filesystem_failures: nine write/short-write/sync/rename failure cases, including injected ENOSPC and final publication-sync unknown outcome
results.quotas: operation count, logical input bytes and manifest-byte quotas; replay still succeeds when full
results.integrity: canonical versioned manifest; unique operations/contiguous generations; size/digest/C04 references; corrupt/missing/unknown/unsafe files fail closed
results.privacy: opaque IDs and hostile metadata remain inert; errors omit input/path/raw OS diagnostics
results.package: web-only dirty package plus checksum verification passed; not engine distribution
results.clone: actual clone/setup/C04 validation/runtime health plus separate actual transport clone of identical snapshot running all Go race tests and vet
results.network: strace of two actual public storage test paths observed no AF_INET calls; not a network sandbox or decoy-isolation proof

candidate_snapshot.scope: unreferenced temporary snapshot for verification; user index/branch/remote refs unchanged; evidence/handoff can be finalized after verification

development_findings: Initial public API tests failed against the missing/storage-error implementation; implemented real filesystem behavior.
A regression first reproduced acceptance/deletion of oversized staging; fixed to preserve suspicious bytes and return recovery error.
Initial standalone trace command used repository cwd rather than tests/; corrected harness cwd without changing production behavior.
observed_limitations: ENOSPC is injected at filesystem calls, not a physically full disk. SIGKILL is not sudden power loss or hardware-flush certification.
Single-host cooperating writer; Linux/ext4 measured only. flock is advisory; same-UID/root and mount manipulation are trusted/outside this boundary.
Synchronous filesystem calls are not forcibly interruptible; contexts are checked around I/O and prior to publication.
Any staging-time failure poisons the handle until Close/Open. Failure after publication is an unknown outcome resolved by reopen/replay.
JavaScript lint is not configured. No remote GitHub Actions/runner apt installation, C28 capacity, authenticated ingest or complete restore/C30 workflow proved.
Strict whole-checkout source integrity passed only for the isolated clean candidate; current workspace remains uncommitted.
No C06 runtime workflow added and no protected database schema/migration/.env/Dockerfile modified.
